content: Protection of ProvidedServiceInstance by IPsec To de- scribe the protection of an ProvidedServiceInstance by IPsec the Provided- ServiceInstance needs to point to an ApplicationEndpoint in the localUni- castAddress role and this ApplicationEndpoint shall point to a NetworkEnd- point that aggregates the IPSecConfig and describes the IPsec Security Associa- tions.
